attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Mississippi state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure (0% up to $10k, 4.4% above) per MS tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Mississippi Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MS tax - Single filer (progressive: 0% up to $10k, 4.4% above)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ms_standard_deduction_single sub result.ms_personal_exemption sub 0 max /ms_taxable_income xdef
0 /ms_tax xdef
ms_taxable_income result.ms_bracket_1_limit gt { ms_taxable_income result.ms_bracket_1_limit sub result.ms_bracket_2_rate mul ms_tax add /ms_tax xdef } if
ms_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Mississippi tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
